attr.title: Need for Speed: Underground
attr.desc: Native static binary recompilation of Need for Speed: Underground (SPEED.EXE) for Rockchip RK3326 and ARM64 Linux handhelds, on the NFSU2 recompilation's runtime.
attr.inst: Copy your retail PC Need for Speed Underground installation files into the ports/nfsu1/gamedata/ folder on your SD card. Required: SPEED.EXE, Global, Cars, Tracks, FrontEnd, Sound.
